notes: CompanyToken is the Company.md (COMD) ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no owner, subsequent minting, burn function, transfer fee, pause or blocklist. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
